summary: La Rosa Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor for 200 shares of Series E Convertible Preferred Stock at $1,000 stated value per share, raising $200,000 gross via a Rule 506(b) private placement. The SPA grants the investor an option to compel additional closings at the same stated value under specified conditions. The Certificate of Designation was previously filed July 9 and disclosed in July 8-Ks. Board recommendation, advisor, and ownership split are not stated. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and conversion terms.
